Select another WebView implementation to stop the crashes

Changing the WebView implementation can fix broken features — such as the copy button and microphone access — and can drastically improve the app\'s overall performance.\n\nThorium WebView is strongly recommended on Huawei devices.

This app has a hidden Settings menu where you can switch to a faster WebView (Thorium is recommended) and optimize performance.

Open it any time from Android's App info screen: tap the gear icon next to "WebGPT".

Note: To download or share an image as a file, long-press it and choose "Download/Share image".
